cohort: 4027 singleton, nulliparous, at-term women undergoing IOL
finding: Maternal age ≥40 years was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section after IOL at term, primarily due to failed induction, but not with other adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women aged 40 and older had a higher likelihood of needing a cesarean section after labor induction compared to younger women.
